title: Compare two linear SVM fits
description: You compare test labels and hinge losses for Pegasos and batch subgradient fits.

steps.description: You fit both models with regularization strength 0.01. Each decision helper uses its own fitted weights and bias.

steps.question: Which label does a decision score of zero receive?
steps.answer: It receives +1 because the comparison uses greater than or equal to zero. Negative scores receive -1.

steps.description: You compute signed margins y*(X@w+b). Hinge loss averages max(0,1-margin), while metrics evaluates the thresholded labels.
You print Pegasos accuracy 0.775 and hinge loss 0.477 in the recording. Batch accuracy is 0.770 and hinge loss 0.478.
